answer: Each identity moors one ferrous anchor to a shale block, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch an ember flare calls a tide pull-test, and the result is logged on the shale register. One anchor holds one chain; a rented anchor snaps under two pulls, burning both bonds. Forging one ferrous anchor costs 50: 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers one ember flare, pays 50 once, and keeps its bond.
